title: Little Paradise - Immersive Player
prompt:
Create a dedicated full-screen immersive player view (/player route) for Little Paradise with a rich Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Key features and architecture according to project documentation (docs/project-details.md):
- Route: /player - Full-screen immersive player environment.
- Ambient Dynamic Background: Deep midnight canvas (#090B12) with ethereal colored radial liquid light flares and atmospheric blur reflecting the album artwork tones (luminous indigo, cyan, deep violet #6a4af0, #8bc5ff).
- Top Header / Chrome:
  - Left: Back/Minimize button ("Collapse to Mini Player" with downward chevron or exit full-screen icon), track status chip ("STREAMING LOSSLESS FLAC 24-bit / 96kHz").
  - Center: Mode Switcher tab pills with frosted glass: [Artwork & Visualizer] / [Synchronized Lyrics] / [Queue & Up Next].
  - Right: Audio Output selector (e.g. "Spatial Audio - AirPods Max / Dolby Atmos"), Sleep Timer indicator (e.g. "30m timer"), Settings gear, and Close / Fullscreen toggle button.
- Main Stage (Two-Column or Centered Immersive Split):
  - Left Side: Big stunning album artwork with 3D glass sheen, subtle vinyl/halo rim lighting, "Celestial Bloom" by Nocturne Theory (or "Midnight Mirage" by Aurora Vale). Include interactive toggle buttons under artwork: Favorite (heart filled/active), Share, Add to Playlist, EQ Preset ("Liquid Spatial"), Speed ("1.0x").
  - Right Side: Live synchronized lyrics panel with floating glass container. Show the active glowing lyric line with real-time word highlighting, karaoke pitch arc, and offset nudge controls (-0.2s / +0.2s). Preceding lyrics faded with high blur, future lyrics softly translucent.
- Bottom Player Control Dock:
  - Large fluid seekbar with glowing scrubber head, elapsed time (01:42), total time (03:45), buffer glow line, and hover timestamp preview.
  - Core playback controls: Shuffle (active glow), Previous track, Big luminous glass Play/Pause button with ripple glow, Next track, Repeat (Repeat One indicator active).
  - Secondary controls: Volume slider with speaker icon and mute toggle, Synced lyrics toggle pill, Audio Visualizer mode switch (Waveform, Spectrum, Particle Orbs), Queue preview button showing "Up Next: Solstice - Ethereal Tides".

Maintain the signature Liquid Glass design tokens: ultra-smooth backdrop blur (28px - 40px), hairline border gradients (rgba(255,255,255,0.12)), deep contrast, Manrope and Inter typography, and violet/sky blue sonic accents.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

The design system establishes an atmospheric, nocturnal sensory sanctuary built for high-fidelity music streaming, immersive audio discovery, and synchronized lyric engagement. Rooted in deep midnight architecture, the aesthetic balances modern minimalism with an ethereal "Liquid Glass" visual philosophy—treating digital surfaces as layered crystal panes that refract and transmit the luminous energy of active music playback.

The target audience encompasses discerning music listeners, spatial audio enthusiasts, and nocturnal creatives who demand both aesthetic calm and exacting tactical utility. Every interaction avoids harsh visual friction, evoking an intimate, late-night headphone session. Vibrancy emerges organically from procedural artwork and atmospheric backdrops bleeding through multi-tiered frosted glass panels, bounded by specular top-edge hairline highlights and soft violet-cyan ambient glows. The tone is sophisticated, serene, and forward-looking—pairing effortless playback ergonomics with rich editorial presence.

## Layout & Spacing

The spatial architecture balances a rigid navigational spine with a fluid, adaptive media workspace built on a strict 4px/8px incremental grid.

- **Desktop Shell Configuration**: Desktop layouts feature a persistent fixed left rail at `16rem` (`256px`) spanning full viewport height. The central content area floats independently with fluid horizontal expansion, bound by a persistent bottom playback bar clearance (`pb-32` / `8rem`) ensuring no content is obscured during active listening.
- **Mobile & Tablet Reflow**:
  - Below `1024px`, the structural sidebar collapses into a top frosted action bar, an off-canvas drawer, and an ergonomic bottom glass navigation bar respecting `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
  - Margin boundaries dynamically scale: mobile operates at `margin-mobile` (`1rem`), tablets at `margin-tablet` (`1.5rem`), and wide screens at `margin` (`2rem`).
- **Grid Patterns**:
  - Media shelves (Playlists, New Albums) use a responsive 2 to 4 column fluid layout with `gutter` (`1rem`) gaps.
  - Mood & Genre cards use a dense 2 to 5 column matrix with `gutter-sm` (`0.75rem`) gaps.
  - Quick Access rows and artist discs leverage horizontal scroll channels (`overflow-x-auto`) with momentum touch snapping and `space-md` gaps.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy does not rely on opaque drop shadows or harsh black outlines. Instead, elevation in the design system is communicated through **Liquid Glass Stratification**: combining progressive backdrop diffusion, light saturation boosts, hairline alpha borders, and specular inner light refraction.

- **Layer 0 (Canvas Base)**: The deep foundation (`#090B12`). Non-reflective, absorbing light to maximize foreground contrast.
- **Tier 1 (Subtle Glass Cards)**: Applied to browsing cards, track rows, and secondary modules.
  - Backdrop Filter: `blur(12px) saturate(140%)`
  - Fill: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)`
  - Edge: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
  - Inset Refraction: `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Tier 2 (Standard Raised Panels & Player Bar)**: Applied to the fixed desktop sidebar, persistent bottom audio chrome, and modal dialogs.
  - Backdrop Filter: `blur(28px) saturate(160%)`
  - Fill: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.065)`
  - Edge: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13)`
  - Shadow: `0 8px 32px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)`
- **Tier 3 (Overlay Glass & Sheets)**: Applied to the slide-out queue drawer and full-screen synchronized lyrics player.
  - Backdrop Filter: `blur(40px) saturate(180%)`
  - Fill: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)`
  - Edge: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)`
  - Shadow: `0 24px 64px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20)`
- **Atmospheric Glows**: Interactive focal nodes (brand insignia, actively playing tracks, hero callouts) generate ambient radial blooms (`box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.25)`), creating optical levitation over dark backgrounds.

## Components

### Buttons & Transport Controls
- **Primary Hero & Play Action**: High-contrast pure white pill (`#FFFFFF`) with dark midnight text (`#090B12`) and medium weight. Scales down smoothly (`active:scale-95`, `150ms ease-out`). Circular play/pause nodes (`36px` persistent bar, `56px` expanded player) maintain subtle upward scale (`hover:scale-105`) and an ambient glow.
- **Glass Action Pills**: Translucent capsule (`rounded-full`) using standard glass fill, brightening on hover (`bg-white/10`) with specular white outline. Used for secondary CTAs (`Explore`, `Show Lyrics`).
- **Transport Icons**: `36px` bounding touch targets with `8px` inner icon sizing. Inactive states rest in Muted Cool Slate (`#9299AB`), transitioning to Crisp Snow (`#F8FAFC`) on hover, or snapping to Luminous Lavender (`#A78BFA`) when toggled (Shuffle, Repeat, Favorite).

### Chips & Mood Nodes
- **Genre & Discovery Pills**: Bordered translucent chips (`rounded-full`, `px-4 py-2`), transitioning from subtle glass to raised glass on hover.
- **Mood Cards**: Expansive cards (`rounded-2xl`, `h-24`, `p-4`) hosting rich diagonal gradient fills (e.g., violet-to-indigo, sky-to-slate, amber-to-orange) overlaid with a 20% dark scrim, top-edge specular line, and bold Manrope typography.

### Input Fields & Scrubbers
- **Glass Search Input**: Seamless translucent container (`rounded-2xl`, `px-4 py-3`) with inset icon, borderless input field, Crisp Snow entry text, and Muted Cool Slate placeholder.
- **Audio Scrubber Bar**: Slim `4px` horizontal rail with an unobtrusive dark trough (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`). The active playback duration renders in Luminous Lavender (`#A78BFA`), crowned by an `8px` glowing thumb that appears on hover/drag. Timestamps sit alongside in `tabular-nums`.

### Track Lists & Row Cards
- **Track List Items**: Linear glass rows (`rounded-xl`, `px-3 py-2.5`). Rest state is transparent; hover activates subtle glass fill (`rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`). Includes leading track index (replacing with animated equalizer waves when active), small album artwork, two-tier title/artist stack, duration, and trailing action menu.

### Cards & Procedural Artwork
- **Album Containers**: Square `1:1` cards (`rounded-2xl`) using procedural multi-stop diagonal CSS gradients derived from track seed data. Finished with a subtle radial specular sheen (`radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent 60%)`) and an animated spinning vinyl ring token during playback.

### Player Chrome & Synchronized Lyrics
- **Persistent Player Bar**: Fixed 3-column liquid glass bar across the lower viewport: left group (album thumb, track info, favorite icon), center group (transport controls, scrub slider, timers), right group (volume slider, queue drawer toggle, expand player button).
- **Synchronized Lyrics Feed**: Full-height vertical reading container. Active lyric line sits anchored at 1/3 viewport height with high contrast, gradient text masking, and semibold prominence. Out-of-focus lines step downward in size, opacity, and apply depth-of-field Gaussian blurs. Manual user scrolling automatically reveals a floating glass pill: `Jump to current line`.
- **Queue Drawer**: Slide-out high-elevation glass sheet (`blur-lg`, `saturate-180%`) featuring drag-and-drop track reordering, clear queue actions, and sticky section subheaders.
